said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
🚨 LAST CHANCE to register for our Youth Career Fair TOMORROW!

Come hear from astronaut Dr. Jeanette Epps about her incredible journey to space and the path that got her there! 🚀

Don’t miss your chance to explore career opportunities and connect with professionals who can help shape your future.

Register NOW! https://t.co/t7M55e86r7

New opportunities. New headshot. 

Come out to our Youth Career Fair THIS SATURDAY!

Register at https://t.co/Q1hDFTO8dN today! https://t.co/7voBhhPMiF

Republicans proposed over $57 billion in cuts to veterans' benefits and services. Democrats opposed those cuts.

Instead, we pushed through the Major Richard Star Act which would end the unfair reduction in retirement and disability pay for nearly 60,000 combat-injured veterans. https://t.co/4H2wIHBHEh

Trump said he was targeting the “worst of the worst.”

Yet Maria Flores Garcia, a Parkdale High School valedictorian and University of Maryland student aspiring to become a doctor, is detained alongside her mother in Louisiana after a routine immigration check-in.

This is cruel. This is disgusting. This is un-American.

Team Maryland is doing everything we can to bring Maria and her mother home.

We will never stop fighting for our immigrant neighbors, and we will not stand by while Trump terrorizes our communities.

Happy Veterans Day! 🇺🇸

As the son of a veteran, today is personal to me. We owe our veterans more than gratitude. We owe them the benefits and quality care they've earned through their service to our country.

Let's honor their sacrifice with action and make sure no veteran is ever left behind!

From his handling of deadly military strikes to this endless war of choice in the Middle East, Hegseth has a lot to answer for.

Republicans may have blocked accountability for now, but come January, House Democrats will pick up right where we left off.

Secretary Hegseth has got to go.

The national security concerns surrounding NVIDIA’s CEO scandal with a Chinese spy demand more than an internal investigation.  The Department of Justice must launch a full investigation, including into the Commerce Secretary’s role.  Follow the evidence. Expose any https://t.co/yTNX2tWz8u

President Trump may admit that his immigration policies went too far, but appointing Stephen Miller as his Chief of Staff tells a different story.

He's doubling down on the same reckless immigration agenda and preparing to take it even further. https://t.co/4f6ap5NqwF

Happy Diwali! 🪔

My office was proud to join Hyattsville’s first community Diwali celebration. It was a wonderful opportunity to learn about Diwali traditions and celebrate the cultures that make our community special.

Wishing everyone celebrating a joyful and prosperous Diwali!

After Republicans suffered historic losses on Tuesday, you'd think Trump and his party might rethink two years of chaos and corruption.

Instead, they're doubling down by putting Stephen Miller, the man whose immigration policies are behind 2 American deaths and over 60 migrants https://t.co/LaKVor4J1j

All year long, I've been raising serious questions about the Trump family's financial dealings.

Accountability is not optional. I said it then: Somebody needs to be looking at this now.

That somebody is House Democrats on January 3rd. https://t.co/VDSyEAoppf

From Eleanor Roosevelt High School to WNBA Champion! 🏆🏀

Congratulations to Prince George's County's own Kaila Charles on this incredible achievement!

Your journey is an inspiration to young athletes across Maryland's Fourth District and a reminder of the talent that comes from our community.

Holding Trump accountable and tackling the affordability crisis must go hand in hand.

That means investigating the Trump family's billions in profits while working to lower gas, grocery, and housing costs.

America, we hear you. Come January, we're getting straight to work. https://t.co/zFbJ4qKUAX

We got the House. We got the Senate.

Now it's time to get to work.

Black lawyers have played a critical role in advancing civil rights and strengthening our democracy.

It was great to join the Howard Law Journal's 23rd Annual Wiley A. Branton Symposium to discuss their legacy and the future of the legal profession.

Honoring that legacy means inspiring the next generation to get involved, make their voices heard, and continue the fight for equal justice.

posts.text:
🚨 IT'S ELECTION DAY! 🗳️

The decisions we make at the ballot box today will shape the direction of our country for years to come.

Your voice matters. Your vote matters. Don't let this day pass without making both count!

Maryland polls are open until 8 PM.

📍 Find your polling place: https://t.co/8Ss2wWUUse

$30 MILLION back in the pockets of Maryland's Fourth District constituents!

Whether it's securing delayed tax refunds, resolving issues with federal agencies, or helping constituents access benefits they've earned, my team is committed to getting results.

Need help with a case? Visit https://t.co/jU8LSYISzP to get started.

Magnet schools don't just recognize talent. They develop it!

It was great joining Magnet Schools of America to discuss how public school choice is opening doors for students through specialized education and hands-on career opportunities. https://t.co/Tn7Fdspud0

The scariest thing this Halloween? The prices.

From candy to groceries, Americans are paying more while corporations rake in record profits. Families are getting tricked at the checkout line, and it’s time we put an end to it. https://t.co/ouvBMvPBWI
https://t.co/W2GzxijFeQ

The right question could open the door to your future! 🎓

With my Youth Career Fair just two weeks away, here are five questions to help you make the most of the opportunities available!

📅 November 14 | 10 AM – 12 PM
📍 Charles H. Flowers High School

Register today: https://t.co/i2RqjcJ3tZ
https://t.co/id7Wp9qIgm

The right question could open the door to your future! 🎓

With my Youth Career Fair just two weeks away, here are five questions to help you make the most of the opportunities available!

📅 November 14 | 10 AM – 12 PM
📍 Charles H. Flowers High School

Register today: https://t.co/R7oFueKLgB

As Breast Cancer Awareness Month comes to a close, we stand with those battling breast cancer and honor the lives we’ve lost.

Educating others about the importance of early detection can save lives. Let’s continue raising awareness and fighting for better access to lifesaving care.

The Trump administration is gutting our federal workforce, and Americans are paying the price.

I sat down with Skye Perryman, CEO of Democracy Forward, to discuss the impact these attacks are having on federal workers and the services millions rely on.

Check out their Harms Report on their website to learn more about how these attacks are impacting everyday Americans and undermining the government services our communities depend on.

The Trump administration’s attacks on our federal workforce are hurting more than just federal employees. They’re gutting the agencies and services millions of Americans rely on.

I hosted a federal workforce roundtable with @SkyePerryman of @DemocracyFwd and Delegate Boafo to hear firsthand how these actions are impacting workers and our communities, and how we can reverse this in the 120th Congress.

🚨 Early voting ends TOMORROW!

The stakes are too high to sit this election out. Decisions made at the ballot box will shape our communities and our country's future for years to come.

Get to the polls and VOTE!
https://t.co/VorSjbphfY https://t.co/oRIwAxDpWv

We're almost TWO WEEKS away from our Youth Career Fair! 🎉

Whether you're interested in college, trade schools, apprenticeships, or becoming a content creator, there's a path for you!

📅 November 14 | 10 AM–12 PM
📍 Charles H. Flowers High School

Register today: https://t.co/9dtTP6FcpI

Cleaner, quieter, fully electric rides have arrived at UMD! 🐢🚌

Nearly $40 million in federal funding is helping modernize UMD's shuttle fleet, giving students more sustainable transportation around campus while saving an estimated 130,000 gallons of diesel annually.

Proud to have supported this investment since day one and excited to see its impact on students and the College Park community!

It was great partnering with the Prince George’s County Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority for a Community Resource Fair, connecting residents with local organizations, essential services, and opportunities available right here in our community.

Thank you to all our community partners for helping us make these resources more accessible!

Trump is bragging about making a “freaking fortune” while holding millions in oil and gas stocks. Meanwhile American families continue to suffer at the pump.

Thanks Trump for putting more money into your own pocket while taking from the American people! https://t.co/myEVPuswl0
Pete Hegseth must answer for his decisions and conduct as Secretary of Defense. https://t.co/3UMV61Roii

Over two decades ago, Metro Laundry Service started as a small Black-owned business with just 10 employees.

Today, they've grown to over 120 workers and are the only Black family-owned commercial laundry business in the nation!

I had the opportunity to tour their facility and https://t.co/R0wdrDCKK2

NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has been named #3 of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026!🚀🌌

This groundbreaking achievement is a testament to the incredible scientists, engineers, and innovators at NASA Goddard right here in Maryland’s Fourth District.

Breakthroughs like this don't happen without sustained investment. As the Trump Administration threatens NASA funding, we must fight to protect the resources that make American scientific leadership possible.

Americans, do you feel like you’re “making a fortune?”

Because while you’re suffering at the pump, Trump is bragging about the $2 Billion+ he’s made this term. https://t.co/caNKQsFDll

There’s no one-size-fits-all path to success!
 
This year’s Youth Career Fair is bringing together more than just colleges. From vocational schools and apprenticeships to content creators and industry professionals, we’re giving students the opportunity to explore different paths and make valuable connections for their futures.
 
📅 November 14 | 10 AM–12 PM 📍 Charles H. Flowers High School
 
Register today at https://t.co/jU8LSYJqpn!

Getting our communities to the polls is more important than ever!

It was great to join Dr. Barbara Williams-Skinner, Pastor John Jenkins, and local clergy for Pulpits to the Polls to discuss voter participation and concerns surrounding transparency and accountability in our communities.

Are Americans better off today than they were two years ago?

For too many working families, the answer is a resounding NO. While Americans struggle with rising costs, Trump continues to line his pockets. 

Democrats are committed to holding this entire administration accountable https://t.co/jrqLPQn3tu

I’m proud to have received a score of 100 on the @HRC’s Congressional Scorecard!

During the 119th Congress, we defeated nearly all anti-LGBTQ+ provisions pushed by MAGA Republicans. I am proud to have fought back against these attacks and will continue to defend LGBTQ+ freedoms. https://t.co/1t1xRfhVvb

College isn’t the only path to success, and our young people deserve to explore every opportunity available to them!

We’re bringing back our Youth Career Fair to connect students with exciting career pathways, including vocational training and certification programs.

📅 https://t.co/aVlx2UC3F9

Maryland, get out and VOTE! 🗳️

Early voting begins tomorrow, October 22 through October 29. The stakes couldn’t be higher, and the future of our democracy is on the ballot.

Don’t wait until Election Day. Visit https://t.co/X65jPN3FXK to make a plan and make your voice heard! https://t.co/B4wgFhynMU

A big win for Prince George’s County’s veterans! 🇺🇸

Strong communities start with conversations that lead to action!

I joined the Prince George’s County Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta for a Town Hall to discuss the challenges facing our community and the importance of voting, especially in this upcoming election.

Thank you https://t.co/e7vJinCH6L

Neither President Trump nor ICE agents are above accountability.

When DHS and DOJ fail to investigate misconduct by federal agents, state and local prosecutors must be able to step in and pursue justice.

We must demand full accountability from President Trump and his administration, including consequences for any federal agents who violate the law.

It was great to join the Central Maryland Chamber of Commerce's Aerospace & Aviation Summit to discuss building on the great work of institutions like NASA Goddard and creating more pathways for Maryland students to pursue STEM careers.

As the space economy grows, Maryland's economy should grow with it. Let's keep that opportunity right here at home.

This is what civic engagement looks like!

A Republican-majority Board of Elections denied on-campus early voting sites for NC A&T and UNCG. What did the students do? They marched 45 minutes in droves to cast their ballots.

Their determination carries forward the legacy of https://t.co/ZSnTScsnIu

Hispanic Heritage Month may be over, but our commitment to the families who strengthen our communities continues.

Salvadoran families are our neighbors and contribute to Maryland’s economy. Now, uncertainty surrounding TPS threatens their futures.

I spoke with Telemundo about https://t.co/peDDdRI56P

On World Food Day, we recognize the 48 million Americans, including 1 in 5 children, who experience food insecurity. No one should go to bed hungry.

House Democrats are working to restore food assistance to the millions of Americans who had it ripped away by Republicans’ cruel https://t.co/Xu1E1KXAf0

Yesterday was Purple Thursday, a day to stand in solidarity with survivors of domestic violence. But our commitment to supporting survivors must extend beyond a single day.

Earlier this week, I visited the Prince George’s County Family Justice Center to hear directly from those https://t.co/SnDQoJF5ON

It was a pleasure to join the BAPS Hindu community in Beltsville for the groundbreaking of their new temple!

This is an exciting milestone for the community and a testament to the continued growth of our district’s rich cultural and religious diversity. https://t.co/qkoprrutqF

A big win for Prince George’s County!

A federal court has temporarily blocked the permanent closure of the Beltsville Agricultural Research Center (BARC), an important step in our fight to protect this vital institution.

Thank you to our local partners who have worked https://t.co/tBMh2pXFyD

We’re officially ONE MONTH AWAY from this year’s Youth Career Fair!

Join me to explore career opportunities and connect with professionals who can help you take your next step!

📅 November 14 | 10 AM–12 PM
📍 Charles H. Flowers High School

Register today at the link in bio! https://t.co/WNnk3hyfRf

Prince George’s County needs more housing that working families can actually afford.

I hosted a housing roundtable with leaders across the housing industry to discuss the 21st Century Road to Housing Act and how we can turn federal housing policy into real progress here at home. https://t.co/W5OQiNuII9

Maryland’s history begins with the Indigenous peoples who first called this land home.

This Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor their enduring contributions to our state and nation, and reaffirm our commitment to preserving their heritage and protecting their rights.

The Secretary of Defense should be focused on ending this war of choice, bringing our men home, and addressing soaring gas prices.

Instead, Pete Hegseth wants to turn an execution into a public spectacle.

We are better than this. https://t.co/UXJzUXsL55

I am heartbroken by the death of Julián Curo-Churata, a Laurel resident, husband, and father who died in ICE custody far from his family. My prayers are with his loved ones.

His family deserves answers, and the American people deserve accountability and transparency. No one https://t.co/VyOky0RXI3

Our democracy depends on checks and balances, accountability, and leaders who respect the rule of law.

With so much at stake, this year's midterm elections are a critical moment for our country. The future of our democracy is on the line, and every voice deserves to be heard. https://t.co/do91zOxUfC

Happy National Space Week!
 
We toured facilities across Florida’s Space Coast as part of the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope launch and saw firsthand the work driving America’s future in space.
 
Continued investment in space exploration means new discoveries and new opportunities https://t.co/mn0KVojmog

Three years after the October 7 terrorist attacks on Israel, we remember the lives lost and all those whose lives have been shattered by the war that followed.

We must continue working to end the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and achieve a lasting peace for Israelis and https://t.co/DpmMKbW4y7

AI is changing everyday life for everyday people, yet they still don’t have a seat at the table.

We need real oversight and accountability that puts people first. Innovation cannot come at the expense of the people it’s supposed to serve. https://t.co/KHl5lFQmoC

It was great to join the DC Chamber of Commerce’s “A View from the Hill” to discuss how decisions on Capitol Hill intersect with the needs of our regional economy.

As new industries emerge and our workforce evolves, federal policy has to keep our region competitive. https://t.co/kFYjeRCn3I

No American city or life is expendable.

Absolutely disgraceful. https://t.co/mORT7Q2CHU

Need some inspiration for this year’s Congressional App Challenge?

Check out RescU, the winning app from last year’s MD-04 winner, Aashi Moola, and hear directly from Aashi as she walks us through her creation.

Do you have the next winning idea? Submit your app by October 26! https://t.co/lL0EvIBLHq

This Banned Books Week, let’s celebrate those making books more accessible, not those trying to take them away.

Proud to have MahoganyBooks, a Black-owned bookstore serving Prince George’s County at National Harbor and now at its new Woodmore location. 📚 https://t.co/5fJq1wQ6c5

Funny how quickly “rigged” mail-in voting became “SO IMPORTANT."

Guess the polls will do that to you. https://t.co/MZhYneD4fy

Today, we celebrate Pastor Henry P. Davis III on 26 years of pastoral leadership at First Baptist Church of Highland Park.

Congratulations on this incredible milestone and many more years of service to come! https://t.co/hNSJmCxxV6

They call it the Protect College Sports Act. What it really is is the Protect College Profits Act.
 
The bill would restrict athlete compensation, meanwhile coaches already making $13M have no caps on their salary.
 
College athletes didn’t create this problem. We shouldn’t make https://t.co/m2hWtSFRtE

AI isn’t taking a 7 week recess. Congress shouldn’t either.

We have bipartisan legislation on the table in the House to address the risks of AI. But we can’t debate it, improve it or pass it when Speaker Johnson sends the House home.

We should be in Washington doing our jobs. https://t.co/xL7dan7mHk

I’ve been on the move recently, meeting with leaders across housing, health care and our military.

No matter the topic, these conversations help me stay connected to the issues affecting Marylanders and the people working on them every day. https://t.co/cm5VrsDcFK

Lose millions investing in the President’s scam of a memecoin just to buy corrupt access to the White House?

Nope, I’m good!

I’ll stick to my chili for lunch and doing the job the people of Maryland’s Fourth District elected me to do. https://t.co/OFNGGXOtHk https://t.co/X1q8jUkplx

Republicans proposed over $57 billion in cuts to veterans' benefits and services. Democrats opposed those cuts.

Instead, we pushed through the Major Richard Star Act which would end the unfair reduction in retirement and disability pay for nearly 60,000 combat-injured veterans. https://t.co/4H2wIHBHEh

Trump said he was targeting the “worst of the worst.”

Yet Maria Flores Garcia, a Parkdale High School valedictorian and University of Maryland student aspiring to become a doctor, is detained alongside her mother in Louisiana after a routine immigration check-in.

This is cruel. This is disgusting. This is un-American.

Team Maryland is doing everything we can to bring Maria and her mother home.

We will never stop fighting for our immigrant neighbors, and we will not stand by while Trump terrorizes our communities.

Happy Veterans Day! 🇺🇸

As the son of a veteran, today is personal to me. We owe our veterans more than gratitude. We owe them the benefits and quality care they've earned through their service to our country.

Let's honor their sacrifice with action and make sure no veteran is ever left behind!

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.

post.text:
Prince George’s County needs more housing that working families can actually afford.

I hosted a housing roundtable with leaders across the housing industry to discuss the 21st Century Road to Housing Act and how we can turn federal housing policy into real progress here at home. https://t.co/W5OQiNuII9

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
